high_level_description: This image captures a nighttime scene featuring a prominent minaret illuminated by streetlights. The minaret is the central focus of the image, standing tall against the dark sky. It has a series of lights along its structure, creating a warm glow that contrasts with the cool blue tones of the night sky. The background includes a mosque with multiple domes and arches, partially obscured by the minaret. The mosque appears to be made of stone or a similar material, and its architectural details are faintly visible in the dim light.
